Kwame and I have collaborated closely over the past two years, primarily on cross-team initiatives at AdvertiseX. His role as a Staff Platform Engineer has been pivotal in aligning our infrastructure strategies with the company’s rapid growth. He’s a consistent presence in daily standups, often stepping in to resolve blockers for developers and DevOps teams alike. His approach to problem-solving is methodical, and he’s never hesitant to challenge assumptions—whether about cloud architecture or process inefficiencies.  

Kwame’s work with AWS forms the backbone of our platform’s scalability. He’s mentored junior engineers on best practices for cost management, ensuring resources are allocated without unnecessary overhead. His CI/CD pipelines are a model of reliability, with automated testing and deployment workflows that cut deployment times by nearly half. Terraform is another tool he’s mastered, using it to standardize infrastructure across environments and reduce manual errors. Monitoring and alerting systems under his care are proactive, catching issues before they escalate.  

One standout moment came when a Kubernetes cluster faced a critical outage. Kwame diagnosed the root cause within hours, coordinating with multiple teams to restore service while minimizing downtime. His calm under pressure and deep technical insight were critical. He also spearheaded a cost-optimization project that rearchitected our EC2 usage, saving thousands monthly without sacrificing performance.  

Kwame’s reliability and technical depth make him an asset. He balances complex systems with simplicity, and his willingness to share knowledge elevates the entire team. I’d wholeheartedly recommend him for any role requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
